name: What is the typical process for a small business remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a small business remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, our team will conduct an on-site visit to assess the space and gather necessary measurements. We then develop a detailed proposal including design concepts, material selections, and a transparent cost estimate. Once approved, we handle permitting, scheduling, and project management, keeping you informed at each stage from demolition to final walk-through. Our goal is to minimize disruption to your business operations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, site assessment, proposal development, permitting, and project execution, with clear communication throughout.
